prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit IMAGE 1, the complete original illustration with the sword held diagonally down-left. IMAGE 2 is the user's enlarged crop identifying the curved/bent blade.

USER CORRECTION: Keep the ORIGINAL DIAGONAL SWORD POSE. The request is to straighten the sword's construction, NOT to stand it vertically or change the pose. The sword tip is explicitly allowed to remain OUTSIDE the frame. Do not zoom out or reframe to include the tip.

Lock the current pommel, handle, right-hand fingers, wrist, arm and their angle/position. Extend the EXISTING handle's straight diagonal axis continuously through the guard socket and down-left along the entire blade. Imagine one ruler laid down the center of the current grip and extended toward the lower-left: the blade's spine, central black fuller and tang must all follow that EXACT straight line. The guard-to-blade connection must be coaxial with the handle, no angular step or offset.

Replace the visibly serpentine/S-bent shape of the current blade with a STRAIGHT rigid black-and-silver sword. Both main silver cutting edges must be straight with a gradual consistent taper. The black central channel must be completely straight, not zigzag, scalloped, hooked or bowed. Gold ornamental fins/thorns can project out from the sides, but they are decoration attached to the straight structural blade; they must NOT make the central blade curve or bend. Preserve the sword's premium black/silver/gold material palette and ornate gold fantasy ornament language. A clearly straight blade takes priority over preserving the old crooked contour. Use the existing diagonal grip as the sole geometric reference; do not rotate the entire weapon into another pose.

The blade will naturally extend diagonally OFF THE LOWER-LEFT SIDE of the canvas. This is desired and permitted. DO NOT shorten it, bend it or turn it vertical to fit. DO NOT relocate or redraw the hand, raise the forearm, change the wrist or change the stance.

Everything outside the blade and its immediate structural connection stays the same as IMAGE 1: same face, short silver hair, slim white/silver/gold armor, right-hand grip, other hand, body, boots, cape, background architecture, aura, light, color, crop and 2:3 composition. Preserve the existing detailed unified 2D anime/painterly artwork. One sword only. No text, guide line, annotation, UI, logo or watermark.
